info.title: Unified IP Information API
info.description: Fork of jason5ng32/MyIP exposing a unified, machine-consumed IP information surface. Lookup data (about an arbitrary queried IP) and egress-probe data (about the deployment's own outbound IP) are strictly separated namespaces. This document covers the endpoints implemented in the current release; planned routes land here together with their implementation, never before.

source.description: Provider key, e.g. maxmind / ipapi_is / ipinfo / ippure

geo.description: MaxMind local-DB shape; null when the database is unavailable (see errors[]).

errors.description: Per-source failure list. Empty array = every source succeeded; a missing quality key always has a matching entry here.

ProviderQuality.description: Per-provider blocks, keyed by provider name. Absent key = that provider failed (see errors[]) or is not enabled for this route. ippure and ipgeolocation appear on the self route only — the first answers about the connection peer, the second is opt-in per deployment (V1_IPPURE_ENABLED / V1_IPGEOLOCATION_ENABLED, both off by default). The remaining key-driven sources appear on every route.

QualityResponse.description: Provider verdicts without the geo block — for consumers that only need proxy/VPN/abuse signals and want neither the MaxMind payload nor its attribution requirement.

privacy.description: null when the deployment's ipinfo plan lacks the privacy add-on.

IppureQuality.description: Self-lookup only, and only when V1_IPPURE_ENABLED is on. IPPure answers about the direct connection peer; a subject mismatch is rejected with a 422 errors[] entry rather than served as visitor data.

AbuseIpdbQuality.description: Crowd-sourced abuse confidence over the last 90 days (ABUSEIPDB_API_KEY).

IpqsQuality.description: Fraud score plus proxy/VPN/Tor verdicts (IPQS_API_KEY). IPQS reports quota and key failures as HTTP 200 with success:false; those become errors[] entries, never an all-false quality block.

IpgeolocationQuality.description: Threat signals from ipgeolocation.io (IPGEOLOCATION_API_KEY). Self-lookup only, and only when V1_IPGEOLOCATION_ENABLED is on. The security block needs a paid plan; on a free plan every field here is null while raw.asn / raw.company are still populated.

Ip2locationQuality.description: Proxy verdict plus ASN / usage context from ip2location.io (IP2LOCATION_API_KEY — the same key the legacy /api/ip2location route reads). is_proxy is null when the plan withholds it, never false — an unanswered question is not a clean address.

is_proxy.description: null when the free tier does not answer the question — not a clean address.

raw.description: asn as upstream sends it — a bare string here, unlike ipdata's nested object — plus org / usage_type / address_type when present.

IpdataQuality.description: Threat verdicts from ipdata.co (IPDATA_API_KEY). Every field is null when the response carries no threat block — an unanswered question, not a clean address.

raw.description: The asn object as upstream nests it, plus blocklists when upstream supplies any — a free key reports both.

get.summary: Look up the calling visitor's own IP
get.description: Anonymous self lookup. The inspected address comes from Express's configured trusted-proxy chain (TRUST_PROXY; exactly one loopback hop by default), not from caller-selected headers or parameters. Results aggregate every configured provider in parallel under a shared 8s deadline; per-source failures land in lookup.errors[] without failing the request.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: BCP-47 tag for localized MaxMind names; normalized to the GeoLite2 supported set.

200.description: Aggregated self-lookup payload (possibly partial — check lookup.errors).

400.description: Client IP could not be determined or is not publicly routable.

503.description: Every lookup source failed for this request.

get.summary: Look up an arbitrary IP address
get.description: Key-gated lookup of an address the caller supplies. Requires a valid X-API-Key; anonymous callers are limited to the self route. The address is validated before any upstream call (malformed and reserved space are refused), then the same aggregation runs as for the self lookup, over the key-driven sources. IPPure is never consulted here: it answers about the direct connection peer, so it would describe the deployment's own egress.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address. Reserved space (RFC 1918, loopback, CGNAT, link-local, documentation, ...) is rejected with 400.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: BCP-47 tag for localized MaxMind names; normalized to the GeoLite2 supported set.

200.description: Aggregated lookup payload (possibly partial — check lookup.errors).

400.description: Address is missing, malformed, or not publicly routable.

503.description: Every lookup source failed for this request.

get.summary: Provider verdicts for an arbitrary IP address
get.description: The same providers, address validation and failure accounting as /api/v1/ip/{ip}, with the geo block omitted. MaxMind is never consulted, so the payload carries no geo attribution obligation. Both self-route-only sources are absent here too: IPPure answers about the direct connection peer, and ipgeolocation is opt-in per deployment.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address. Reserved space (RFC 1918, loopback, CGNAT, link-local, documentation, ...) is rejected with 400.

200.description: Aggregated quality payload (possibly partial — check errors).

400.description: Address is missing, malformed, or not publicly routable.

503.description: Every quality source failed for this request.

200.description: The OpenAPI contract of the /api/v1 surface.
